# Tripple K Car Hire & Transfers

> Affordable and reliable car hire, airport transfers, chauffeur and wedding packages in Nairobi, Kenya. Book online at https://trippleklogistics.com

Tripple K Car Hire is a trusted vehicle rental and transport company based in Nairobi, Kenya. We serve individuals, corporate clients, and special occasions across Kenya.

## Services

- [Car Hire / Self-Drive](https://trippleklogistics.com/cars): Self-drive car rentals in Nairobi and across Kenya. Available daily and weekly. No hidden charges.
- [Airport Transfer](https://trippleklogistics.com/#airport-transfer): Reliable pickup and drop-off at JKIA (Jomo Kenyatta), Wilson Airport, and other Kenyan airports.
- [Chauffeur Service](https://trippleklogistics.com/#chauffeur): Professional driver-guided transport for business, VIP guests, and leisure.
- [Wedding Packages](https://trippleklogistics.com/#wedding): Elegant vehicles for weddings, decorated on request.

## Fleet

- **Saloon / Sedan**: Toyota Axio, Toyota Premio, Nissan Tiida — comfortable city and highway travel
- **SUV / 4x4**: Toyota Land Cruiser Prado, Toyota RAV4, Mitsubishi Pajero — ideal for safaris, upcountry, and rough terrain
- **Executive**: Mercedes-Benz E-Class, BMW 5 Series — VIP transport and corporate travel
- **Van / Minibus**: Toyota Hiace (14-seater), Toyota Noah (8-seater) — group transfers and corporate shuttles

[Browse full fleet](https://trippleklogistics.com/cars)

## Pricing

All prices in USD. Self-drive cars from $25/day. Prices vary by vehicle category — see live rates at https://trippleklogistics.com/cars

## How to Book

1. Browse the fleet at https://trippleklogistics.com/cars
2. Select your vehicle and travel dates
3. Complete the online booking form
4. Receive instant confirmation
5. Or chat directly on WhatsApp for assistance

## Rental Requirements

- Valid National ID or Passport
- Valid driver's licence (minimum 2 years driving experience for self-drive)
- Minimum age: 23 years
- Refundable security deposit: $150–$500 depending on vehicle category
- No driving outside Kenya without prior written consent

## Location & Coverage

- Based in Nairobi, Kenya
- Serve all major cities and towns in Kenya
- Airport transfers to/from JKIA, Wilson, Eldoret, Kisumu, Mombasa airports

Tripple K Car Hire is a Kenyan-owned and operated vehicle rental business. Our fleet is regularly maintained and insured. We are committed to safe, reliable, and affordable transport solutions for every budget.
